d: For Reno Raines, taking refuge in a small-town saloon becomes hazerdous.
When Reno witnesses the cold-blooded murder of one of his trusted street pals, Reno himself becomes the victim of a brutal beating at the hands of the killers.
At the moment before Reno apprehends a murderer, a helmeted motorcycle rider breaks up the party with a pistol.
The pipe-bomb murder of Reno's ex-partner Jack Varnell sends Reno and Bobby south of the border in search of the cop-killer.
Reno's latest job gets personal - the bounty is on the head of Earl Lyons, an ex-Army Ranger from Reno's unit.
Reno falls into a deadly trap when false news reports claim that Valerie Prentice, his comatose fiancee, has awakened.
Reno assists a stranded motorist change her flat tire who later turns up dead.
Reno's latest bounty kidnaps a wealthy Japanese businessman's daughter.
Appearances are deceiving, when Reno discovers a look alike is committing crimes in his name.
Reno rolls into town, tracking a gang of vicious cutthroats.
A desperate psychotic escapes from a prison with a plan for revenge against the men who put him behind bars: Reno and Bobby.
The five-year old disappearance of B-movie starlet sends Reno south of the border, following a hot tip from one of Bobby's informants.
When crooked Circuit Prosecutor Eli Starke hires some local thugs to thwart the efforts of a group of ex-convicts trying to go straight, Reno comes to their rescue.
Reno's old friend, D.A. Harry Wells, recruits him to help find his daughter Dawn, who is being held hostage by her drug-dealing boyfriend.
A ghost from Reno's past appears and convinces him that his older brother Mitch, who went MIA over Cambodia 17 years ago and whom the government declared dead, is still alive.
Reno's only means of saving himself and his brother is to break the psychological hold that Bracket's lies have over Mitch by reminding him of their past.
By returning home to honor the one-year anniversary of his fiancee's death, Reno puts himself precariously close to Lt. Dixon's deadly clutches.
Reno may have met his match when Bobby sends him after a former heavyweight boxing champion turned convicted killer.
